findings.title: Equal timestamps reorder equity by value
findings.detail: A same-tick equity sequence100→90 and two same-timestamp entry fees reported the earlier larger equity. Stable time sorting now preserves observation order.

findings.title: Maximum relative drawdown was selected by dollar loss
findings.detail: 100→50 then1000→800 reported -20% instead of the actual -50% maximum. Dollar and percentage maxima now have coherent independent episode fields.

findings.title: Invalid fill side or nonpositive price fabricated FIFO P&L
findings.detail: Every side other than buy was interpreted as a sale. Unknown sides and nonpositive prices now cannot create closed-trade profit.

findings.title: Malformed journal containers and oversized integers crashed the report
findings.detail: Scalar fills/carry and a1001-digit timestamp raised TypeError/OverflowError. Adapter validation now treats malformed evidence as unavailable.

findings.title: Every snapshot rescanned the full history
findings.detail: A100-snapshot known-answer fixture visited30301 input rows. Snapshot grouping and ordered flow/event consumption now keep input row visits below1000 while preserving final equity299 and capital basis100.

findings.title: Nonfinite rendering inputs crashed presentation
findings.detail: Infinity, NaN, booleans, huge integers, invalid progress counts and out-of-range activity timestamps no longer crash or appear as valid financial figures. Valid .5 signals and3/10 progress still render.

findings.title: Missing freshness evidence appeared as a live price stream
findings.detail: Running=True with absent, invalid or negative snapshot age now warns that freshness is unavailable; observed age0 still reports healthy.

findings.title: Portfolio test escaped its service mock and owner log path
findings.detail: The uninstall called a real label-based launchctl bootout after its mock exited. Install also attempted mkdir on the owner log directory. Both service calls and log_path now stay inside temporary/mocked boundaries. Current guards stopped the red attempts before bootout/mkdir execution.

findings.title: Headless default reads escaped offline fixtures
findings.detail: 47 UI tests passed assertions while the guard blocked Coinbase product listing and compound-agent launchctl print calls. Assigned UI class fixtures now enter the shared offline_console_reads helper; explicit inner action mocks remain effective.
